    types_list = list(types)
    if not types_list:
        return Any
    
    # Separate typed dicts from other types
    typed_dicts = [t for t in types_list if is_anonymous_typed_dict(t)]
    non_typed_dicts = [t for t in types_list if not is_anonymous_typed_dict(t)]

        result_types.append(shrunk_typed_dict)
    
    if not result_types:
